methodology.fps: Nearest-rank distribution of completed one-second RAF windows; incomplete final window excluded
methodology.apply: performance.now around interpolation, pose writes and render receipts inside useFrame; GPU draw execution excluded
methodology.frameAge: Local time since accepted network receipt; playout delay separate
methodology.source: Distribution of polled latest stats at approximately 1 Hz; repeated latest values may occur, not a per-step/per-publish timing distribution
methodology.timing: Startup, correctness pause/resume and warmup excluded from raw frame window
methodology.comparison: Use identical source tree, scene assets, source configuration, viewport, camera, WebGL renderer and useful output counts; no candidate comparison is performed here
limitations: Shared workstation; background contention is not isolated
Browser clock quantization may produce zero apply samples; zeros do not imply zero work
Source latest-stat polling cannot establish per-operation readback/publish p95
